summary: Allarity Therapeutics filed an 8-K solely to announce that its active pharmaceutical ingredient manufacturing campaign for stenoparib is on track for completion by Q3 2026, supporting a planned pivotal trial in advanced ovarian cancer. The press release highlights operational progress, FDA Fast Track designation, and that all manufacturing payments are complete. No terms, prices, premiums, or structural changes typical of special-situations categories are present. This is a routine business update on drug development progress, not an event-driven special situation.
